name: Gnerdel
description: An Ogre philosopher who believed life's purpose was to live as high on the food chain as possible.

description_citations.text: Fourth Edition: card flavor text (Fourth Edition, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gnerdel refuses to eat vegetarians, living on creatures that prey on sentient beings.
